description: Create a compressed rollup checkpoint of workflow history. Call this periodically to prevent token explosion when recovering from context compression. Returns checkpointId, compressed event history, chainIntact status, and nextCheckpointHint (recommended events before next checkpoint).

endTime.description: Unix ms end time (optional, default: now)

fromEventId.description: Start of range by eventId (optional, use with toEventId)

startTime.description: Unix ms start time (optional, default: 1h ago)

toEventId.description: End of range by eventId (optional, use with fromEventId)

name: pot_checkpoint
